title: A great trip!
text: The trip was really well organised and so ran very smoothly: our guide, Merce, was very friendly and knowledgeable. The walk itself is not challenging (I wouldn't call it a 'hike') but the views are incredible and well-worth making the trip for. We were really happy with the day.
author: Aisleigh_S

title: Great trip to Caminito Del Rey
text: Great trip, appears to be very chaotic but everyone found their way. Trip guide and actual tour guide were really good, very friendly and approachable. You do arrive back in Seville much later than I expected and there is quite a lot of hanging around at times. Definitely recommend if you are fit and healthy, may struggle if you are not active - we walked about 15km during the whole day.
author: A1279WMjackiel

title: Very interesting hike
text: Very beautiful experience, very interesting explanations from the guide.  Magnificent views. I recommend this tour without hesitation.
author: scaiai

title: Exceptional
text:
A fantastic experience at the Caminito del Rey! 🌿
The trail offers truly unique views and natural scenery. It is not a demanding hike, so it is suitable for everyone (provided you do not suffer from vertigo!). A special round of applause for Gabriele, our guide: attentive, very knowledgeable, and super nice. Highly recommended! ☺️
author: L5286TYelenab

title: Must do!
text:
Such an amazing experience! This is a must. 
The whole trip was seamlessly from pick up to drop off. Our tour guide Martina was so lovely and stayed with us the whole time. 
We had stops in between to get lunch and snacks. 
I recommend doing this!
author: andrah197

title: Unforgettable experience
text:
We contacted the Naturanda agency to organize a private tour for 10 people from Seville to the Caminito del Rey and the experience was simply perfect.
They organized everything down to the smallest detail: pickup directly at the hotel by minibus, professional driver, and private guide in Italian.
The booking service was impeccable, very helpful and very fast. A special thanks to Desiree who completely customized our request by creating a tailor-made tour for us.
The tour itself was wonderful, but a truly heartfelt thank you goes to our guide Mercede, exceptional, very well-prepared, passionate
author: 212elvirau

title: Camenito del Rey
text: Very nice tour. Osuna is just ok, nothing special. The canyon is impressive, worth the time in the bus. Benoit is a very professional, informative and attentive guide
author: Quest826232

title: Fantastic. Caminito  Del Rey Experience!
text:
Fantastic day from start to finish! The Caminito del Rey hike is spectacular and our guide Pepe (female) was enthusiastic and knowledgable. The pace was good and if you walked closer to the back of the group you had more opportunity to take photos.
This  is a long day so be prepared to leave Seville at 10am and get back around 9:30pm. Take a packed lunch and snacks and bring cash if you want to buy a drink/coffee or food during the trip. title: Spectacular
text:
I was delighted to do this hike in nature; I was able to admire the breathtaking landscapes 
The history of this old canal is very interesting 
Our guide Ayman was adorable and funny; he spoke several languages, including French 
On-site, the guide was very interesting when telling the history of the Caminito

author: graziellal983

title: Definitely a must
text: Fabulous day out, well worth it if you’ve done everything you want to in Seville. Guides were excellent, well organised. Only things to know, it’s more 12 than 10 hours if going from Seville. Definitely bring your own food as food options are limited. I’m scared of heights but was determined to do it and it was ok and I did enjoy it.
author: Puffingoesexploring
